decisions.reason: The camera sits close to the core offer and has a page of its own in a growing industry, so results likely meet aspiration and the firm's slack lets it carry the product through long space sales cycles.

The modular navigation camera fits the strategic push toward flexible, compact sensors for small satellites and has prominent web presence, so there is no shortfall to trigger search for alternatives.

Space situational awareness is a growing field that builds on existing competencies, and although demand is less proven, the hiring and R&D-rich firm has the slack to keep it while results remain uncertain.

The miniaturized LiDAR matches the firm's direction toward compact docking and navigation sensors, and its mere mention on the website signals an early stage rather than failure, so a growing, slack-rich firm would likely keep developing it.
